findings.location: Paragraph containing Proverbs quote (source.html second paragraph of political discussion / translation paragraph 6)
findings.source_quote: The spiritual Truth is this: The king’s heart is in the hand of the LORD, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will –Proverbs 21:1.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the incorrect Bengali book name "গীতসংহিতা 21:1" with the correct Bengali name for Proverbs, e.g. "নীতিবচন 21:1". Keep the verse number and the translated verse text. Example corrected translation fragment: "আধ্যাত্মিক সত্য হলো: ... – নীতিবচন 21:1।"
findings.translation_quote: আধ্যাত্মিক সত্য হলো: রাজার অন্ত্য: করুণাময় রবের হাতে; সে নদীর জলের মতো তাকে যেখানে ইচ্ছে ফিরিয়ে দেয়। – গীতসংহিতা 21:1।

findings.location: Heading and paragraph about "Moses in Midian" (source.html paragraph starting 'In “Moses in Midian”' / translation paragraph 5 and the quoted title)
findings.source_quote: In “Moses in Midian”, we take a walk in Moses’ footsteps during the mid-section of his life.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the target-language rendering of the proper name Moses and the article title. Replace "মধ্যিয়ানে মোসস" and other instances of "মোসস" with a conventional Bengali form such as "মোশে" (or "মূসা" if the publication's style prefers that). Example: "“মধ্যিয়ানে মোশে”" and "মোশে" in running text.
findings.translation_quote: “মধ্যিয়ানে মোসস” লেখায় আমরা তাঁর জীবনের মধ্যাংশে মোসসের পদচারণায় হাঁটছি।
